reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Mississippi
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Does the law specify a minimum number of days a tenant can be late on rent
    before the landlord can file an eviction action for nonpayment?
*/

% -----------------------------
% Scenario (facts + statement)
% -----------------------------

scenario_state(mississippi).
scenario_focus_year(2021).
scenario_issue(nonpayment_eviction_minimum_late_days).

% The scenario statement succeeds when the encoded question context is present.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(mississippi),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_issue(nonpayment_eviction_minimum_late_days).

% -----------------------------
% Statute encoding (deterministic)
% -----------------------------

/*
  MS Code  89-7-27 (2020), Second:
  Eviction/removal for nonpayment may proceed after:
    - default in payment of rent pursuant to the agreement, AND
    - rent/late fees cannot be fully obtained by distress of goods, AND
    - three (3) days' written notice requiring payment or possession has been served.
*/

% MS Code  89-7-27 (2020): three (3) days' written notice requirement for nonpayment default.
statute_ms_89_7_27_nonpayment_notice_days(3).

% MS Code  89-7-27 (2020): minimum notice must be served before proceeding on nonpayment removal.
% (We model this as a minimum-days threshold associated with nonpayment eviction process.)
statute_minimum_days_before_nonpayment_eviction_action(mississippi, Days) :-
    statute_ms_89_7_27_nonpayment_notice_days(Days).

% -----------------------------
% Legal reasoning helpers
% -----------------------------

% The law "specifies a minimum number of days" if it provides a numeric days threshold
% tied to starting/proceeding with a nonpayment eviction action.
law_specifies_minimum_days_for_nonpayment_eviction(mississippi, Days) :-
    statute_minimum_days_before_nonpayment_eviction_action(mississippi, Days),
    integer(Days),
    Days > 0.

% For this Q, we treat the specified minimum as the statutory notice period (3 days).
% (Mississippi's statute does not create an additional "grace period" before default;
% it does specify a 3-day written notice requirement tied to the eviction process.)
law_specifies_minimum_late_days_before_filing(State, Days) :-
    law_specifies_minimum_days_for_nonpayment_eviction(State, Days).

% -----------------------------
% Answer
% -----------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    law_specifies_minimum_late_days_before_filing(State, _Days),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

% -----------------------------
% Main / Entrypoint
% -----------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does the law specify a minimum number of days a tenant can be late on rent before the landlord can file an eviction action for nonpayment?
